title: Local Advertisers Begin the Move to Connected TV - MNTN Research

facts.fact: According to eMarketer, local brands increased their spending on digital video and OTT by 26.2% in 2021.
facts.quote: According to eMarketer, 2021 saw many local brands follow their national counterparts with a 26.2% increase in spending on digital video and OTT.

facts.fact: The page states that in 2021 CTV was the largest growing ad channel for local advertisers, without naming a source for this claim.
facts.quote: In 2021, CTV was the largest growing ad channel for local advertisers as they shifted some budget away from paid search and into the newest TV solutions.

facts.fact: Per the page, Nielsen created Media Markets, which segment the US into 210 distinct geographic areas used for TV geotargeting.
facts.quote: Created by Nielsen, Media Markets were a way to segment the US into geographical areas–210 distinct markets.

facts.fact: The page says the Borrell Associates Benchmarking Study noted local advertising shifting away from paid search during the second year of the pandemic, with some budget moving into Connected TV.
facts.quote: Borrell Associates Benchmarking Study noted local advertising shifting away from paid search during the second year of the pandemic, investing some of this previous budget into Connected TV.

facts.fact: The page states that on linear TV, specific inventory was reserved for local businesses, usually the last ad spot of a commercial break.
facts.quote: On linear TV, specific inventory was reserved for local businesses; usually the last ad spot of a commercial break.

facts.fact: The page states that linear TV reporting is usually delivered after a campaign is over, so adjustments cannot be made during the flight.
facts.quote: Linear TV reporting is usually delivered after a campaign is over so there is no way to make adjustments during the flight.
